title: Austin 183 West Annexation Hearing
summary:
*   A special public hearing was held to discuss the potential annexation of the U.S. 183 West area.
*   The hearing saw significant public engagement, with 228 citizens signing up to provide input.
*   The meeting was extensive, lasting over four hours and adjourning late at 11:15 p.m., indicating thorough discussion on the annexation proposal.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
Mayor Watson called the meeting to order. SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
OCTOBER 14,1997-7:OOP.M.
1. Public hearing on the annexation of U.S. 183 West Luther Polnau, City of Austin Manager
of Information and Planning, gave a brief overview.
228 Citizens signed appearance cards (on file in City Clerk's Office) ADJOURNED at 11:15
p.m. on Councilmember Slusher's motion, Councilmember Spelman's second, 7-0 vote.
Approved on this the 23rd day of October, 1997, on Mayor Pro Tern Garcia's motion,
Councilmember
Spelman's second, 7-0 vote.
